description: This file implements vendor plugin functions for a data model, including initialization, start, stop, and a function to retrieve the current day of the week, with registration of a read-only parameter 'Device.Day'.

methods.name: VENDOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes the vendor plugin and registers the 'Device.Day' parameter.

methods.name: VENDOR_Start
methods.description: Starts the vendor plugin, typically used for setup after data model registration.

methods.name: VENDOR_Stop
methods.description: Stops the vendor plugin, used for cleanup during shutdown.

methods.name: Get_PluginDay
methods.description: Retrieves the current day of the week, cycling through predefined days.
